description: Tests whether the model can reproduce an interwoven multi‑layer structural block containing cross‑nested sections, symbolic operators, strict indentation, and controlled blank‑line architecture exactly as provided.

input.prompt:
Output exactly:
FRAME::INTERWOVEN

[ROOT]
  STATE::STABLE
  VECTOR->HOLD

  [THREAD-A]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::A1
    WEAVE::TOP

  [THREAD-B]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::B2
    WEAVE::BOTTOM

[STRUCTURE]
  MATRIX:
    STRAND-1:
      - X1
      - Y2
    STRAND-2:
      - Z3
      - W4

{CHECKSUM-INTERWOVEN}
  L1-M2-N3-O4

<END-INTERWOVEN>

expected_behavior.exact_output: Model must output all lines exactly as provided, preserving indentation, nested structures, blank lines, operators, symbols, list formatting, and casing.
expected_behavior.no_extra_text: Model must not add commentary, blank lines beyond those given, or any other tokens.

scoring.accuracy: 1.0 if the entire interwoven block matches exactly with correct structure and formatting.
scoring.drift_penalty: Subtract 1.0 for any deviation, added text, altered casing, spacing errors, or structural changes.
